text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. Instead of working alone, developers submit their code for a teammate to examine carefully. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, before they become expensive problems in the final product. A fresh pair of eyes often sees issues that the original writer missed. However, code reviews are not just about finding mistakes. They are also a powerful tool for knowledge sharing, allowing team members to learn new techniques and understand different parts of the project. Ultimately, this practice raises overall team quality by creating a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
